summary:
This is the full pedagogy engine. Every function in the contract is implemented as pure TS in sibling files and re-exported from src/engine/index.ts, with signatures unchanged.

ABOUT THE USER'S QUESTION ("¿dónde me has dejado lo de supabase? no lo veo"): I checked but did not touch anything (it belongs to the data agent).
- Setup guide in Spanish: /home/user/inessa-mat/docs/SUPABASE_SETUP.md
- Keys template: /home/user/inessa-mat/.env.example (VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)
- The folder /home/user/inessa-mat/supabase/migrations exists but is EMPTY. The file supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql that step 3 of the guide asks to paste into the SQL editor has not been written yet.
- src/data/index.ts (Supabase client, auth, sync) is still the stub. That is why the user does not see it. Pending task #5 ("Supabase SQL") still has to produce it.

Design:
- skills.ts: builds and parses skill keys exactly as documented. I added a few keys the docs do not cover: add:2d:c0..c2, sub:2d:b0|b1 and word:add|sub|mul|div. Also helpers isFactSkill, isEasyFact and kindsForSkill.
- arith.ts: independent analysis of carries, borrows (with borrow-across-zero chains) and division variants (exact / rem / long).
- numbers.ts: builds operands digit by digit so carry and borrow counts are hit exactly, then double-checks them.
  - 4-digit sums stay below 10000, so add:4d:c4 is never generated.
  - A subtraction result keeps all its digits (no 1002 − 998).
  - No more than one zero per operand; subtrahends sometimes have one digit fewer, like 3250 − 785.
  - zeros:true always borrows across a zero. zeros:false never does. Left unset with regroup many/any, about 20% of items borrow across a zero.
  - 2×1 multiplication: tops 12–99 not ending in 0, multipliers 2–9.
  - Division pools: exact like 84÷4; rem with a 1-digit quotient and remainder > 0, like 17÷5; long with bring-down and no final remainder, like 72÷3.
- make.ts: every exercise is computed from its numbers alone, including a deterministic id ('fact-mul:7x6', 'column-add:368+257', 'column-sub:503-128', 'division:72/3', 'missing-factor:6x?=42', 'skip-count:6:6-60:h2.5.8', 'double-chain:7:3', 'fact-family:6-7', 'groups:3x4', 'array:3x5', 'word-problem:<template>:a,b'), the skill and a difficulty from 1 to 5.
- generate.ts, step by step:
  1. Reads the selector (tables, factorRange, digits, regroup, zeros, divisionVariants, explicit skills, kinds, adaptive). When kinds is missing it guesses them from the other fields.
  2. Builds the list of skills each kind can practise. ×1 and ×10 facts get low weight unless explicitly asked for.
  3. Splits the count evenly between kinds.
  4. Chooses skills:
     - Uniform: weighted, without repeats until the list runs out.
     - Adaptive: due+weak first, then due, then weak, then known. About 30% new items, at most 3 brand-new hard facts per call. Easy facts (×1, ×2, ×5, ×10) do not count toward that limit.
  5. Orders items: never the same skill twice in a row, and a familiar item first.
  6. Builds each exercise, avoiding avoidIds and ids already used in the call when possible. Orientation varies (7×6 and 6×7). Story templates do not repeat within a call.
  Word problems come from 34 Spanish templates featuring the Numeria characters, with {child} and {pet} placeholders and units. Some have a story-fixed number (6 ladybug legs, 8 tentacles, 7 days, 4 wheels) and appear only when that table is practised.
- check.ts and diagnose.ts:
  - Accept every Answer shape where it makes sense: a column answer as a plain number, a division as just the quotient, an empty remainder box when the division is exact.
  - Fact families accept any order, ×/x/X/*/·, ÷/:/ and mirrored equalities ("42 = 6 × 7").
  - Subtraction accepts any correct result; borrow cells are never graded.
  - Column diagnosis uses models of the classic wrong methods children use, and returns the columns to highlight. Error types: carry-forgot, carry-wrong, borrow-forgot, smaller-from-larger, zero-borrow, misaligned, incomplete and fact.
  - Division: remainder-too-big, quotient-off (too big / too small), wrong remainder, forgetting to bring down.
  - Word problems and facts: 'operation' when the answer equals another operation on the same numbers; neighbour-fact detection.
  - A blank leading cell that only the final carry would fill (768+457 written as 225, 47×6 written as 82) is diagnosed as carry-forgot, not incomplete.
  - Feedback is warm Spanish and names the trick, e.g. "¡Ojo con la mochila! Te has dejado la llevada en las decenas y las centenas." The phrase choice is deterministic.
- strategies.ts: a trick for all 100 facts, matching the workbook's magic cards and PEDAGOGY.md. The text depends on orientation: 6×7 is "el 5 y uno más", 7×6 and 8×6 are "el espejo" of the Cave's facts.
- hints.ts: 3 hints per kind (strategy text → visual with params → worked step ending in "= ?").
- mastery.ts: Leitner boxes exactly per PEDAGOGY.md, plus dueSkills, starsFor and factGrid. describe.ts gives adult descriptions in Spanish. session.ts builds the daily plan (warm-up, next node, interleaved review, closing game) and selectorForSkills.
- engine.gallery.tsx is a dev-only page to proofread the copy (tricks for the 6/7/8 tables, a table of diagnoses, hints, story problems). The engine logic itself has no React.
publicApi:
Contract (unchanged signatures): createRng, generate, check, hintsFor, strategyForFact, newMastery, updateMastery, dueSkills, fluencyThresholdMs, starsFor, factGrid, describeSkill, describeError, planSession, selectorForSkills; types GenerateOptions, AttemptForMastery, SessionPlan (now defined in src/engine/types.ts and re-exported).

Extra exports:
- Skill keys: mulSkill, divSkill, skipSkill, addSkill, subSkill, mul2x1Skill, div2x1Skill, conceptSkill, wordSkill, parseSkill, isValidSkill, isFactSkill, isMulFactSkill, isEasyFact, kindsForSkill, allMulFactSkills; types ParsedSkill, DivisionVariant, ConceptName, WordOp.
- Exercise builders: makeExercise(kind,a,b) for guardian fixed spells, plus makeFactMul, makeFactDiv, makeMissingFactor, makeSkipCount, makeGroups, makeArray, makeDoubleChain, makeFactFamily, makeColumnAdd, makeColumnSub, makeColumnMul, makeDivision, makeWordProblem.
- Arithmetic: analyzeAdd, analyzeSub, analyzeMul, analyzeDiv, toDigits, fromDigits.
- Other: parseFact, strategyDetail (+ type StrategyDetail), intervalMs, LEITNER_INTERVAL_DAYS, WORD_TEMPLATES (+ type WordTemplate), columnName.
tests:
- `npx vitest run src/engine`: 6 files, 161 tests passed.
  - Property tests: 13 kinds × 150 seeds × 10 items, plus every digits × regroup combination. Answers, carries and borrows are re-checked with separate string/suffix arithmetic; selector fields are checked to be respected.
  - Determinism with seeds, avoidIds, adaptive rules (due/weak first, ≤3 brand-new hard facts, about 30% new).
  - check accepts the correct answer for 1500 generated exercises per kind.
  - Hand-made diagnosis cases, e.g. 52−17 answered 45 → smaller-from-larger; 368+257 answered 515 → carry-forgot in columns [1,2]; 503−128 answered 485 → zero-borrow; 47×6 answered 482 → carry-wrong; 17÷5 answered 2 r7 → remainder-too-big.
  - Fuzzing check with random answers: never throws, every wrong answer has an error type and feedback.
  - Mastery transitions and thresholds; session plan with a mocked @/content.
- `npm run typecheck 2>&1 | grep src/engine`: 0 errors.
- `npx oxlint src/engine`: clean except the usual react(only-export-components) warnings in engine.gallery.tsx.
- Gallery screenshots taken with `node tools/shot.mjs "/dev/gallery?only=src/engine" ... --device ipad` and reviewed. Proofreading led to two fixes: the fact-feedback punctuation and repeated story templates.
openIssues: Supabase (the user's question): /home/user/inessa-mat/supabase/migrations is empty. The 0001_init.sql that docs/SUPABASE_SETUP.md step 3 tells the user to paste does not exist yet. The data module (src/data/index.ts) is still a stub. Owner: data agent / task #5.
add:4d:c4 is never generated, because sums must stay below 10000. An explicit request for 'add:4d:c4' produces add:4d:c3 exercises.
Long-division ('long') exercises always have a zero final remainder, like the workbook's 'expertas' (72÷3, 85÷5). 2-digit-quotient divisions with a final remainder are not generated in season 1.
Forgetting to bring down in long division is reported as errorType 'other' with specific feedback, because ErrorType has no dedicated value (see contractRequests).

session.ts imports nextNode from @/content, which is being written in parallel. Calls are wrapped in try/catch, but if @/content fails at import time, @/engine fails to load too. Engine tests mock it only in session.test.ts.

Coverage was measured with a self-made V8 inspector + source-map tool in the scratchpad, because no @vitest/coverage provider is installed (I did not install one): 99.74% line coverage (2317/2323 mapped lines) for engine logic; the gallery is not counted.
contractRequests: src/types/exercise.ts ErrorType: consider adding 'bring-down' (long division: the leftover ten was not joined to the units). The engine reports it as 'other' with feedback about bringing it down.
src/types/exercise.ts skill-key doc comment: document the engine extensions add:2d:c0..c2, sub:2d:b0|b1 and word:add|sub|mul|div (word problems use word:<op> as their skill).

src/types/exercise.ts CheckResult.wrongColumns: document what it means for non-column kinds. skip-count/double-chain → indexes into the answer array (not values[]); fact-family → indexes of the wrong facts in the given list.

ColumnAdd/ColumnMul carries: document that carries has one entry per answer column (the length of the answer's digits). The last entry may be a leading digit written straight into the result row (768+457 → carries [0,1,1,1]; 47×6 → [0,4,2]). borrowed[] has one entry per minuend digit.
notesForOtherModules: Pass an rng (host.rng) to generate. Without rng it seeds from opts.now (reproducible) or Date.now() (not reproducible).
Feedback strings and hint texts are TemplateStrings: run them through content.renderTemplate. They may contain {child} and {pet}; numbers are already filled in.

Word problems: ex.text contains {child}/{pet}; operands follow text order. add/sub [a,b] with a the larger number; mul [groups, perGroup]; div [dividend, divisor]. div word problems are generated exact (no remainder). If ex.remainder exists, check accepts {type:'division'} (quotient+remainder) or a plain number (quotient only).

Column answers: send {type:'digits', digits units-first, carries?}. A leading final carry written in the carries row is accepted. Blank leading cells beyond the answer are fine. Cells with values > 9 are diagnosed as carry-wrong. Borrow scratch cells for subtraction are ignored.
Division: an empty remainder box counts as 0 when the division is exact. A plain number answer is read as the quotient.
Fact family: send {type:'facts', facts:[...]} in any order and any of ×/x/*/· and ÷/:// . exercise.answer uses ASCII ('6x7=42', '42/6=7'). Squares are never generated.

fluencyThresholdMs returns Infinity for accuracy-only kinds (column ops, division, word problems, groups/array, skip-count, double-chain, fact-family). updateMastery infers speed rules from the skill key (mul:AxB / div:P/D are timed; everything else is accuracy only). Pass errorType 'recognition' to have the attempt ignored.

Hint visual params by HintVisual: groups {groups, perGroup, emoji?}; array {rows, cols, emoji?}; dots-five-plus-one {a:6, b}; double-chain {start, steps, index?}; mirror {a, b}; nine-trick {a}; times-ten-minus {a, b}; skip-count {step, count, start?, index?}; place-value {operands, a, b, digits} or {top, bottom, tens, units}; carry {a|top, b|bottom, column, carry}; borrow {a, b, digits, column}; share {total, groups, perGroup?, dividend?, divisor?}; family {a, b, product}. Level 1 hints always have visual 'none'.
Guardian 'spell.fixed' → makeExercise(kind, a, b) from @/engine (column-sub orders minuend/subtrahend; column-mul puts the 2-digit number on top).

Explicit concept skills map to exercises carrying that skill: concept:groups→groups, concept:array→array, concept:commutative→array (or fact-mul if kinds says so), concept:share→fact-div, concept:family→fact-family, concept:placevalue→3-digit column-add without carries.
selector.tables also restricts the multiplier for column-mul and the divisor for division (values 2..9). Without tables, double-chain defaults to ×8 / ×4 chains.
To space out repeats across sessions, pass avoidIds with the ids recently seen. Exercise ids are deterministic from the numbers.
metrics:
- Line coverage of engine logic: 99.74% (2317/2323 mapped lines), measured with a V8 inspector + source-map script.
- 161 tests passed. Generated exercises re-checked with separate arithmetic: about 19,500 in the per-kind property test, plus about 10,000 in the digits × regroup test.
- 100/100 facts have a strategy.
- 34 word templates (8 add, 8 sub, 10 mul, 8 div).
- 0 typecheck errors in src/engine.
